title: RefractMC
description: RefractMC tries to simulate Minecraft, but as a AAA Game.
body:
**_RefractMC – Redefining Minecraft's Visuals_**

Forget everything you thought you knew about Minecraft's aesthetics. **RefractMC** isn't just another modpack, it's a _graphical revolution_. Engineered for high-end hardware that accepts no compromises, this AAA-grade pack transforms your world into a living, breathing masterpiece.

_**✨ Why RefractMC?**_

**Next-Gen Lighting**: Experience physically _accurate light calculations_ that turn every sunrise into a cinematic event.

**_Hyper-Realistic Textures:_** From the finest pebbles to majestic mountain ranges. Every block is optimized for maximum immersion.

**_Living Atmosphere:_** Dynamic weather, realistic water physics, and an ambient soundscape that drops you right into the heart of the wilderness.

**_AAA Performance:_**
A meticulously curated selection of optimization mods ensures that every frame counts, even with high-end visuals.

**_🛠️ Technical recommendations_**

This pack utilizes the absolute pinnacle of _modern modding technology._ Whether it's ray-tracing shaders or high-resolution 3D models, **RefractMC** is built to push your GPU to its absolute limit.

**_Warning:_** This modpack is highly resource-intensive. Recommended for players who don't just want to play Minecraft, but experience it.

**_Tip: Download [Eclipse shaders](https://github.com/Merlin1809/Eclipse-Shader) for one of the best visuals._**
